english.title: Federal Reserve Board announces consent prohibition involving former First Security Bancorp employee
english.excerpt: The Federal Reserve Board said on Thursday that it executed a consent prohibition against Rush F. Harding III, a former employee of First Security Bancorp, over breach of fiduciary duty and violation of Regulation W.
summary: The Federal Reserve Board announced the execution of an enforcement action on Thursday.
The action is a consent prohibition against Rush F. Harding III.
The notice identifies Harding as a former employee of First Security Bancorp.
The stated issues are breach of fiduciary duty and violation of Regulation W.
english.body:
Federal Reserve Board action

The Federal Reserve Board said on Thursday that it executed an enforcement action listed in its notice. The action is a consent prohibition involving Rush F. Harding III. Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

The notice identifies Harding as a former employee of First Security Bancorp. It cites breach of fiduciary duty and violation of Regulation W. Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
